english.title: Gross indecency with a girl under fourteen years of age
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) committed an act of gross indecency with or towards **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a girl under the age of 14
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Indecency with Children Act 1960.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
commit an act of gross indecency
with/towards a girl under the age of 14

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE - Section 39 of the Criminal Justice and Courts Services Act 2000 raised the age to 16 years with effect from 11.1.01. now see H537 and CJS Code IC60002

(i) See also offence wording: H9821 - which relates to a male victim.
(ii) This offence is included in Schedule 1 to the Sex Offenders Act 1997. Therefore a person convicted or cautioned for this offence must comply with the requirements of section 2 of that Act.
(iii) This offence is included in Schedule 2 to the Sex Offenders Act 1997. Therefore a person committing this offence outside the United Kingdom may in certain circumstances be prosecuted for that offence in England, Wales or Northern Ireland.
(iv) See Sexual Offences (Conspiracy and Incitement) Act 1996 for incitement to commit offences outside the United Kingdom where the victim is under 16 years old. This Act came into force on 1.10.96 and relates to acts or events occurring on or after that date.
(v) Section 39 of the Criminal Justice and Courts Services Act 2000 raised the age to 16 with effect from 11.1.01.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Ten years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
